details.method: Before a fixture starts production after restoring a CLI model, wait within its original deadline for the real public catalog to be current, ready and not loading with a discovered source. Select the current picker item without yielding, then retain actual backend, model and capacity immediately before the action.
details.when: A native editor acceptance fixture restores persistent model text and must distinguish a manual option from the actual runtime model catalog.
details.counterexample: Matching model identifiers alone can match a restored manual option. A later ready status does not prove readiness at the earlier action. These observations do not establish which prerequisite failed in a historical run without its snapshot.
details.trial_plan: In the next independent registered cold-start consumer, delay actual discovery while restoring the same manual ID; require no production action before discovered readiness, one real action after readiness, and explicit failure with a retained snapshot when the original deadline expires. Do not weaken production guards or extend the deadline.
